correctness.rationale: With odd p the invertible r+r^{-1} supplies a reflection-odd radical uniformizer u, yielding A≅k⟨u,s⟩/(u^p,s²−1,su+us), J=uA. An explicit four-family basis gives [E_i,F_j]=H_{i+j+1} and [H_i,E_j]=2E_{i+j}, [H_i,F_j]=−2F_{i+j}, with all C_i central; the coefficient 2 remains nonzero. Induction yields precise lower-central Lie terms of dimensions 3(ℓ−j)+1 and 3(ℓ−j); L_{p−1}=kH_ℓ≠0=L_p. Nilpotence J^p=0 allows truncated exp/log and Lazard in class p−1<p, identifying every group lower-central term. Independent standard-library calculations checked primes 3,5,7,11,13,17, all 6561 p=3 ordered unit pairs, and truncation identities over 3,5,7. Finite checks support but are not the general proof.

value.rationale: Successive lower-central factors, exact class and generator rank are classical and classification-relevant invariants for the unique Sylow p-subgroup of a modular group algebra. This family exhibits a provable alternating rank pattern at every odd prime and sharpens a prior class bound to equality, which cannot be inferred from centre and order alone. The full graded profile is nontrivial structural data, not a one-off table or an arbitrary numerical slice.
